operations.description: Parse observed local Delft-FEWS PI XML events with the archived HKVFEWSPY parser, returning values, timestamps and quality flags.

vendor_files.embedded_notice: Christian Stefanescu; embedded MIT declaration. Only parse_raw is reachable through the adapter.

operations.archive_head_vs_installed_release: Exact archived function/method bytes are vendored. No upstream distribution is installed or claimed; no older release is substituted for archive HEAD.
limitations: One unprefixed series with explicit timeZone=0; complete moduleInstanceId/locationId/stationName/parameterId/units header.
Every event requires explicit date,time,value,flag,user attributes to avoid upstream optional-user column-length failure.
UTC restriction preserves, without repairing, upstream negative time-zone handling. XML prefixes that change SAX attribute names are unsupported.
Only parse_raw is called; URL/filename-detecting untangle.parse is never invoked. No FEWS service activation.

limitations: Values below 7 dBZ become zero; values above 55 dBZ are clipped to 55 dBZ by upstream code.

operations.name: HydroModelsNeuralHydrologyFlowScores
operations.description: Offline hydrologic evaluation of existing observed/simulated discharge, with no neural inference.

data_path.description: Task-relative UTF-8 JSON file; native runtime supplies an immutable private snapshot. Maximum 2097152 bytes.

operations.release_source_equivalence: Only the cited API is adapted. Matching version labels do not assert archive/release byte identity; archived HEAD has not been executed.
limitations: Finite nonconstant equal-length series of 2..10000 samples in m3/s; positive means are required.
Calls only evaluation.metrics.kge/nse/rmse; no configuration, pickle, model loading, training, torch call or weights download.
The metric import closure uses NumPy/pandas/SciPy/xarray and datautils YAML imports. Unrelated training dependencies must not be auto-provisioned.
Archive and selected release both identify as 1.13.0, but byte identity and archive HEAD execution are not asserted.

evidence.observation: Metrics accept one-dimensional xarray DataArray inputs; KGE uses the standard-deviation ratio.
Metric support imports NumPy, pandas, xarray and ruamel.yaml; unsafe scaler/pickle utilities are not called.
Archive declares 1.13.0.

operations.install_strategy: Coordinator must provision the verified 1.13.0 wheel without its unrelated training dependency group, using the exact operation import-closure pins listed here. No torch/CUDA packages are required by this operation.

operations.name: HydroModelsPySTEPSPrecipitationAdvection
operations.description: Semi-Lagrangian deterministic precipitation advection of a bounded local rain grid with supplied velocity.

data_path.description: Task-relative UTF-8 JSON file; native runtime supplies an immutable private snapshot. Maximum 2097152 bytes.

license_records.archive_path: 地学Python工具集/03_水文-水文模型/pysteps/LICENSE

operations.release_source_equivalence: Only the cited API is adapted. Matching version labels do not assert archive/release byte identity; archived HEAD has not been executed.
limitations: All three grids share a 2..128 by 2..128 shape; no optical-flow estimation, stochastic ensemble, model weights, radar downloads or external forecast.
Velocity components are east and south pixels per input step. Lead times are integer multiples of that same step.
Uses one integration iteration, linear spatial interpolation and zero outside the domain. Loss at boundaries is expected.
The reference check uses uniform velocity fixtures with an independent exact transport solution.

evidence.observation: Accepts a (y,x) precipitation field, (2,y,x) velocity, integer timesteps and fixed interpolation options.

evidence.archive_path: 地学Python工具集/03_水文-水文模型/pysteps/setup.py
evidence.observation: Release 1.21.5 builds Cython/OpenMP motion extensions even though this chosen advection kernel is pure NumPy/SciPy.

native_prerequisites: Published 1.21.5 is source-only; provision a CPython 3.12/NumPy 2.1.3-compatible distribution, including its Cython/OpenMP build prerequisites, before activation.

operations.name: HydroModelsTopoFlowSolarFlux
operations.description: Instantaneous top-of-atmosphere horizontal shortwave flux from the original TopoFlow solar routines.

data_path.description: Task-relative UTF-8 JSON file; native runtime supplies an immutable private snapshot. Maximum 2097152 bytes.

operations.release_source_equivalence: Only the cited API is adapted. Matching version labels do not assert archive/release byte identity; archived HEAD has not been executed.
limitations: This is extraterrestrial radiation, not observed surface radiation or a clear-sky atmospheric correction.
Julian day means ordinal day of year, 1..366; the upstream annual-angle approximation uses a 365-day denominator.
Hours are offsets from true solar noon, not local civil time. Equal-length arrays of 1..10000 positions.
Only exact Python-3-compatible solar function excerpts are vendored from this legacy Python-2-era project; the full TopoFlow runtime is not ported.

evidence.observation: Uses Solar_Constant=1367 W/m2, eccentricity, Spencer declination, Earth angular velocity and clamps night flux to zero.

operations.name: HydroModelsPyDEMTerrainDerivatives
operations.description: Tarboton D-infinity slope magnitude and downslope direction from a small elevation grid with explicit metric spacing.

data_path.description: Task-relative UTF-8 JSON file; native runtime supplies an immutable private snapshot. Maximum 2097152 bytes.

license_records.archive_path: 地学Python工具集/03_水文-水文模型/pydem/LICENSE.txt

operations.release_source_equivalence: Only the cited API is adapted. Matching version labels do not assert archive/release byte identity; archived HEAD has not been executed.
limitations: Requires a rectangular 3..128 by 3..128 local metric grid. Horizontal spacings and elevation are metres; no CRS is guessed.
Disables flat filling, pit drainage and path construction. Only the interior (without the one-cell boundary) is returned.
Undefined/flat/pit cells use paired JSON nulls, not an invented flow direction. No contributing area, TWI, GDAL subprocess or external TauDEM engine is called.
The published binary targets CPython 3.11 and glibc 2.41; the common CPython 3.12 profile needs a separately accepted source build. No binary compatibility is assumed.

evidence.observation: Calls the original eight-facet Tarboton implementation. Constructor supports array elevation, dX/dY and conditioning switches.
Archive 1.2.1 declares rasterio/numpy/scipy/geopy/traitlets/traittypes/zarr/cython.
Documents direct array processing with explicit dX/dY.

native_prerequisites: Provision pyDEM 1.2.1 for CPython 3.12 from its sdist, with a compatible compiler/Cython/NumPy headers. The 3.11-only wheel is not usable on the common profile. Validate the array slope operation independently before activation.

operations.name: HydroModelsEXPHydroBucketWaterBalance
operations.description: Original EXP-HYDRO bucket water-balance right-hand side at supplied independent snow/soil states.

operations.release_source_equivalence: Only the cited API is adapted. Matching version labels do not assert archive/release byte identity; archived HEAD has not been executed.
limitations: Computes instantaneous rain/snow partition, melt, actual ET, subsurface/surface runoff and both storage derivatives. It does not integrate a trajectory or claim calibrated simulation.
Stores are mm; forcings and returned fluxes/derivatives are mm/day, temperature/thresholds are Celsius, f is 1/mm and ddf is mm/day/C.
All five state/forcing arrays have the same 1..3660 length. Rain/snow threshold cannot exceed melt threshold.

The archive setup lists only exphydro while the chosen class lives in exphydro.lumped and imports the separate hydroutils package. Exact self-contained class excerpts avoid that incomplete legacy packaging and exclude simulate().

Preserves upstream bucket behavior: at zero soil storage its exponential subsurface runoff can still be positive; returned derivatives may be negative. No artificial clipping or integration is substituted.

evidence.observation: Uses explicit para.*.value parameters and supplied states; calls the original rainsnowpartition/snowbucket/soilbucket methods.

operations.description: Green-Ampt cumulative infiltration and rainfall excess over bounded constant-rate rainfall intervals.

operations.release_source_equivalence: Only the cited API is adapted. Matching version labels do not assert archive/release byte identity; archived HEAD has not been executed.
limitations: Rainfall and saturated conductivity are mm/hour; suction head and cumulative infiltration are mm; each step length is hours.
Effective porosity/saturation remain constant through this bounded sequence. This is an infiltration kernel, not the complete distributed PyTOPKAPI simulation.
The exact archive solver uses scipy.optimize.fsolve for ponding. Nonconvergence and water-bound violations return a fixed invalid_arguments error.
Positive suction/conductivity and saturation <=0.99 avoid singular dry-deficit cases. No arbitrary solver or expressions are accepted.
Archive is an unreleased 0.5.0 development tree with distutils packaging; the original infiltration source is vendored verbatim.

evidence.observation: Piecewise no-rain, unponded, within-interval ponding and whole-interval ponding branches; cumulative wetting-front equation solved with fsolve.

operations.name: HydroModelsSuperflexUnitHydrograph
operations.description: Mass-preserving GR4J UnitHydrograph1 routing of effective rainfall using the actual SuperflexPy LagElement.

data_path.description: Task-relative UTF-8 JSON file; native runtime supplies an immutable private snapshot. Maximum 2097152 bytes.

operations.release_source_equivalence: Only the cited API is adapted. Matching version labels do not assert archive/release byte identity; archived HEAD has not been executed.
limitations: UnitHydrograph1 uses its upstream 2.5-power cumulative S-curve; lag is 1..30 input time steps.
Adds ceil(lag)+1 zero-forcing tail steps so the complete response is reported and terminal state shifting cannot erase a nonzero last output.
Outputs remain mm/step, not volumetric river discharge. No arbitrary framework topology, code, state pickle or model configuration is accepted.
Numba uses the confirmed common version 0.68.0; it is not downgraded to the historical minimum in package metadata.

evidence.observation: Builds bin weights from its 2.5-power S-curve and inherits LagElement routing.
Updates lag states and shifts final states; padding ensures the last state is zero.
Archive version 1.3.3 requires numba>=0.57.1 and numpy>=1.24.3.

operations.name: EarthCatchmodLinearStoreStep
operations.description: Route parallel scenarios for one daily step through the original archived CATCHMOD linear reservoir, returning mean flow, end flow, storage and water-balance residuals.

data_path.description: Task-relative immutable UTF-8 JSON input. Maximum 2,097,152 bytes.

linear_storage_days.description: Linear storage constant in days. The native step duration is fixed at one day.

operations.release_source_equivalence: Worker-owned local build of the exact archived source revision. Local version is a reproducibility label, not an upstream PyPI release. Original mathematical source files must remain byte-identical.

license_records.archive_path: 地学Python工具集/03_水文-水文模型/pycatchmod/LICENCE

evidence.observation: Calls the original compiled daily linear-reservoir algorithm and preserves original source bytes.

limitations: One fixed daily timestep over independent scenarios, not a calibrated catchment forecast.
Initial flow is at least 0.000001 mm/day, explicitly excluding the upstream very-small-flow clamp branch; zero-initial-flow simulation is not claimed.
Water depths and flows are normalized per catchment area; no area or discharge-unit conversion is performed.
Never downloads, builds, installs or loads executable user configuration at tool execution time.

dependency_conflicts.resolution: Do not install/downgrade the full Xanthos distribution. Use the original licensed NumPy-only PET source verbatim.
Do not install the legacy HidroComp distribution or downgrade the profile. Use exact licensed pandas-only RMSE class excerpts.

dependency_conflicts.resolution: Source-ready adapter only until a compatible source build is provisioned and independently accepted; do not install the mismatched binary.

dependency_conflicts.prerequisite: pysteps 1.21.5 source distribution builds Cython/OpenMP extensions.
dependency_conflicts.resolution: Source-ready adapter remains inactive pending compatible native provisioning and numerical acceptance.

dependency_conflicts.resolution: Record both identities explicitly, provision the selected release, and validate the used array criteria before activation.

dependency_conflicts.prerequisite: Full neuralhydrology dependency installation includes unrelated torch training packages.
dependency_conflicts.resolution: Metric-only wheel provisioning must use the declared bounded import closure without torch/CUDA/training dependency installation; no neural model calls.

operations.name: EarthTtimTransientWellDrawdown
operations.description: Evaluate transient drawdown after one constant-rate pumping step in a homogeneous confined aquifer using the TTim Laplace-domain well solution and numerical inversion.
limitations: One pumping well at the origin, fixed radius 0.1 m, single confined layer and no wellbore storage.
Pumping starts at day zero. Drawdown is the negative head change from the zero initial state; output axes are radius then time.
At most 16 radii and 32 increasing times across six decades; M=10 Laplace inversion.
K*t_min/Ss >=100 m2 bounds the finite-radius correction for independent Theis comparison; inversion error remains subject to CPU acceptance.

operations.name: EarthLandlabFlowDirections
operations.description: Route a bounded regular or irregular node-link terrain graph to steepest downhill neighbours using the actual compiled Landlab single-flow-direction kernel.
limitations: All supplied links are active; no implicit geographic coordinates or CRS. IDs are zero based.
Rejects self-links, duplicate undirected links and invalid node IDs. First strict steepest match wins a tie in link input order.
Explicit baselevel nodes receive themselves. Flat/local-low nodes are sinks; receiver_link=-1 indicates no outgoing receiver link.
Executes published 2.10.1, not archived 2.11.1.dev0 HEAD. The published Windows CPython 3.12 wheel SHA256 is bc26f9101987d809cb12894aab3d5e8a2483d69eb67568f683472beb6bb1e9f9.
operations.version_distinction: Execute only the pinned published release; archive HEAD is provenance and was not installed, executed, or claimed equivalent.
native_prerequisites: The matching CPython 3.12 Landlab wheel and its Cython adjust_flow_receivers extension must import and pass CPU acceptance before activation.

operations.name: EarthIrisCubeCorrelation
operations.description: Compute weighted Pearson correlations between matched sample-by-site air-temperature cubes through the real Iris cube statistics API.
limitations: At most 512 samples and 64 sites; matched rectangular finite Kelvin arrays with nonconstant columns.
Weights are strictly positive, one per sample. No masking, missing data, coordinate broadcasting, downloads or file loading.
Sample and site coordinates are dimensionless ordinal axes, not inferred dates or geographic observations.
Published Iris 3.13.1 is distinct from the recorded archive HEAD; no archived-HEAD execution is claimed.
operations.version_distinction: Execute only the pinned published release; archive HEAD is provenance and was not installed, executed, or claimed equivalent.
native_prerequisites: The pinned Iris release and its cf-units/UDUNITS and NetCDF dependency chain must import and pass CPU acceptance; this candidate is not an active tool.

operations.name: EarthPyhspfReachTable
operations.description: Generate the original PyHSPF 15-row reach FTABLE from average flow, velocity, reach length, slope and bounded trapezoidal floodplain assumptions.
limitations: Heuristic reach geometry, not surveyed cross-sections or a calibrated HSPF watershed simulation.
Input mean flow is cubic feet per second and velocity feet per second; source converts using 0.3048.
Retains upstream five width iterations, Manning n=0.05, fixed depth multiples, and upper-floodplain P1 perimeter expression verbatim.
Volume is million cubic metres, surface area hectares. No native HSPF engine or WDM files are accessed.

operations.name: EarthSphyCropEvapotranspiration
operations.description: Apply the original SPHY potential crop evapotranspiration calculation to bounded reference-ET and crop-coefficient series.
limitations: Computes only ETpot=reference ET times crop coefficient using the verbatim SPHY ET module.
Reference ET must already be supplied. This does not compute actual ET, water stress or reference ET from weather.
The full SPHY PCRaster raster engine and catchment configuration remain unsupplied and are not exposed. GPL-3.0-or-later license is preserved.

operations.name: EarthXsboringenLithology
operations.description: Classify bounded CPT friction-ratio/cone-resistance samples with the original xsboringen exponential lithology rules and explicit caller-supplied thresholds.
limitations: Caller-supplied rule tables are not an authoritative regional soil classification. Friction ratio is percent and qc is MPa; a must use the same MPa threshold scale.
Rules use left<rf<=right and qc>a*exp(b*rf), with strict threshold comparison. First matching original table rule has priority.
Intervals inside each rule must be disjoint; no arbitrary expressions, Python or dynamically loaded classes are accepted.

operations.name: EarthEflowMagnitudeIndices
operations.description: Compute five EFlowCalc daily-flow magnitude descriptors: mean, median, mean/median and 90/10 plus 80/20 percentile ratios using the real upstream functions.
limitations: Daily, equally spaced finite nonnegative discharge; the 10th percentile must be positive so every returned ratio is defined.
Uses source ma1, ma2, ma5, ma6 and ma7; these functions do not use date, hydrological-year or drainage-area arguments.
Percentiles use NumPy default linear interpolation; no trend, seasonal or complete-water-year claim is made. GPL-3.0 text is preserved.

operations.name: EarthHydroboxFlashiness
operations.description: Compute the archived Hydrobox Richards-Baker flashiness variant from bounded regularly sampled discharge using its original implementation.
limitations: Preserves the archived denominator sum(x[1:]), which excludes the first discharge value. This differs from the common full-record Richards-Baker denominator.
Requires a positive denominator and regularly spaced nonnegative discharge; no resampling or missing values.

operations.name: MelodistDailyPrecipitationToHourly
operations.description: Disaggregate contiguous daily precipitation totals into hourly interval totals with the upstream mass-conserving uniform method.

data_path.description: Task-relative .json file; runtime supplies an immutable private input snapshot.

start_date.description: Actual calendar date, year 1900..2100; naive fixed 24-hour days.

vendor_files.adaptation: Function/assignment body verbatim; external package metadata/JIT decorators outside excerpt omitted. Fixed bounded array-only invocation; see operation limitations.
Function/assignment body verbatim; external package metadata/JIT decorators outside excerpt omitted. Fixed bounded array-only invocation; see operation limitations.

limitations: 1..366 contiguous, complete, finite daily totals; no gaps, DST, timezone conversion, or stochastic cascade.
Legacy hourly_index gap-handling branch uses removed pandas APIs. Contiguous generated indexes never enter that branch; the archived function bodies are unchanged.

constraints.file_format: UTF-8 JSON object; unique keys; finite numbers
constraints.cross_field_constraints: 1..366 contiguous, complete, finite daily totals; no gaps, DST, timezone conversion, or stochastic cascade.

validation.native_dependencies: no project-level installation; pinned required libraries must be accepted
validation.immutable_input_checker: checks.capture_inputs / checks.assert_inputs_unchanged plus fixture byte hashes

operations.source_release_distinction: The precise archived source excerpts are used, not an installed MELODIST distribution. No full-package API or archive-wide acceptance is asserted.

operations.name: RsudpWindowAmplitude
operations.description: Compute the exact rsudp RSAM mean/median/min/max absolute amplitude on a bounded supplied waveform window.

data_path.description: Task-relative .json file; runtime supplies an immutable private input snapshot.

vendor_files.adaptation: Function/assignment body verbatim; external package metadata/JIT decorators outside excerpt omitted. Fixed bounded array-only invocation; see operation limitations.

limitations: At most 65536 finite supplied samples. Unit is explicitly counts or a caller-calibrated amplitude unit; sample_rate_hz is positive.
No instrument response correction, UDP acquisition, external alert delivery, filtering, overlapping windows, or GUI. duration=N/fs is acquisition duration, not the first-to-last timestamp span.

constraints.file_format: UTF-8 JSON object; unique keys; finite numbers
constraints.cross_field_constraints: At most 65536 finite supplied samples. Unit is explicitly counts or a caller-calibrated amplitude unit; sample_rate_hz is positive.

validation.native_dependencies: no project-level installation; pinned required libraries must be accepted
validation.immutable_input_checker: checks.capture_inputs / checks.assert_inputs_unchanged plus fixture byte hashes

operations.source_release_distinction: The precise archived source excerpts are used, not an installed rsudp distribution. No full-package API or archive-wide acceptance is asserted.

operations.name: SeismicZfpCompressCube
operations.description: Compress a bounded supplied 3D seismic float32 cube into SGZ with the real seismic-zfp engine and report measured CPU round-trip errors.

data_path.description: Task-relative .json file; runtime supplies an immutable private input snapshot.

limitations: Exactly 3 axes; each >=4, inline/crossline <=64, sample extent<=512, total<=32768 values; input JSON <=8 MiB.
Fixed lossy16-bit storage; float32 rounding is reported separately through comparison to actual float32 input, with measured max/RMS errors; no universal losslessness claim.
Only the supplied managed output directory is written. Upstream uses two bounded CPU producer/consumer threads for compression/writing; no GPU or remote executor.
zfpy and segyio native wheels must pass independent CPython3.12/NumPy2.1.3 acceptance. No arbitrary input SGZ/SEG-Y, untrusted model loading, cloud stores, ZGY, or VDS.

constraints.file_format: UTF-8 JSON object; unique keys; finite numbers
constraints.cross_field_constraints: Exactly 3 axes; each >=4, inline/crossline <=64, sample extent<=512, total<=32768 values; input JSON <=8 MiB.

validation.immutable_input_checker: checks.capture_inputs / checks.assert_inputs_unchanged plus fixture byte hashes

operations.source_release_distinction: Archive HEAD c550cd31dc711666139748cd73347461b396122c includes 4D APIs. Only published 0.5.0 NumpyConverter/SgzReader bounded 3D conversion is adapted; no archive commit, 4D, cloud, SEG-Y input, ZGY, or VDS acceptance is claimed.

compatibility_notes: No core profile downgrades requested. Source-ready is not callable-active, and native wheels have not been installed or accepted.
Melodist gap-handling uses removed pandas APIs in the archived helper; adapter enforces contiguous complete daily data to avoid that path without editing its algorithm.
Archive HEAD is recorded separately from every installed package pin. Four published distributions are selected; twelve project operations use precisely hashed licensed source excerpts.
Numba0.68.0 and xarray2026.9.0 are the confirmed reference pins, not the initially considered earlier versions.

Additional release dependency pins are an acceptance proposal, not a claim of a solved or installed unified lockfile. Any resolver/ABI conflict must be reported by coordinator instead of silently replacing core versions.

required_checks: Generate fixtures in a clean acceptance root with fixtures.create; never overwrite existing files.
Resolve exact declared pins against the confirmed CPU reference, inspect distribution licenses, and keep incompatible/native-unavailable operations inactive.
Run every example offline through the shared contract, then checks.check for actual numbers/content; unknown names raise.
Capture input hashes before invocation with checks.capture_inputs and compare afterwards; generated fixtures also have fixed expected byte hashes.
Exercise checks.negative_cases against each example, with overrides applied, requiring code invalid_arguments and repeat-identical error messages.
Reject malformed/duplicate/nonfinite JSON, wrong dimensions, oversize files/arrays, nonphysical ranges and unit mismatches before expensive operations.
Validate the generated SGZ artifact through SgzReader and compare actual decoded samples, time spacing, and measured reconstruction error.
Confirm shared runtime schemas, provenance/artifact hashes, output non-overwrite, bounds, offline imports, and all 134 existing baseline tools remain intact.

operations.name: HydroVICPrecipitationPhase
operations.description: Partition precipitation into liquid rain and snow using the original VIC air-temperature phase kernel. Not a full VIC simulation.

air_temperature_c.description: Air temperature, degrees Celsius, one value per supplied time step.

precipitation_mm.description: Nonnegative precipitation depth per supplied time step, millimetres; same array length as temperature.

max_snow_temperature_c.description: Upper transition threshold, degrees Celsius; must exceed min_rain_temperature_c.

min_rain_temperature_c.description: Lower transition threshold, degrees Celsius; must be less than max_snow_temperature_c.

operations.name: SeismicMadagascarFFT
operations.description: Analyze a real seismic trace with the unchanged archived Madagascar Kiss FFT C kernel. Full unscaled forward DFT, no padding/window/detrending. Not the whole Madagascar suite.

samples.description: Finite real seismic trace samples in amplitude_unit; the original native FFT uses float32.

sampling_interval_s.description: Uniform sampling interval in seconds, greater than 1e-9; no resampling is performed.

amplitude_unit.description: Physical sample-amplitude unit; preserved in real/imaginary values and abs(DFT)/N.

operations.name: GeoHPGLDirectionalSemivariogram
operations.description: Calculate a directional experimental semivariogram from projected 3D samples with original HPGL C++ point-set code. Axis-aligned positive-direction cylinder; not kriging or full HPGL.

x_m.description: Projected easting coordinates in metres; no geographic CRS conversion is performed.

y_m.description: Projected northing coordinates in metres; same length as values.

z_m.description: Projected vertical coordinates in metres; same length as values, caller-defined vertical datum.

values.description: Observed scalar sample measurements in value_unit; not generated or inferred observations.

axis.description: Positive projected x/y/z direction of the original HPGL cylindrical pair search.

lag_separation_m.description: Spacing between lag-bin centers in metres.

lag_width_m.description: Lag-bin width in metres; at most lag_separation_m. Lower edges are inclusive, upper edges exclusive.

first_lag_m.description: First lag-bin center in metres; greater than half lag_width_m to exclude zero separation.

lag_count.description: Number of lag bins, from 1 to 64.

bandwidth_m.description: Transverse cylinder radius in metres for the original HPGL directional search.

value_unit.description: Physical measurement unit; semivariance is returned in its square without conversion.

operations.name: EarthWflowKinematicWaveReachStep
operations.description: Original archived Wflow implicit kinematic-wave solver for one SI reach step, A=alpha*Q**beta. Returns observed outflow and finite-volume continuity; not a complete basin/runoff, PCRaster or Wflow.jl system.

provenance.description: Unmodified shared collection SDK source/contract/input hashes and executing-interpreter exact pins.
